items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:42:1
items.html:
The six lights that were with it entered the vessel of the king called Hesed: That is, by the coupling that was made upon the screen after it was refined to the discernment of Hochma. And the drop of that coupling of AVI face to face of this level, which came down upon the MAN in them, is regarded as the measure of the illumination of the ZON of Hochma of Aba, which, toward the Partzuf of ZON itself, is regarded as its discernment of Haya, as above. And it is this that expanded in the king of Hesed, as explained above at length.
It has already been explained that the screen goes on refining and diminishing from degree to degree until it brings out six more kings besides Hesed. Two levels of them are still in the upper AVI: phase two and phase one, which are the kings of Gevura and of the upper third of Tifferet; and four levels are in YESHSUT, which are phase three, phase two, phase one and the discernment of the root, which are the two thirds of Tifferet, NH, Yesod and Malchut. All these levels were included in phase three, upon which the level of Hochma of Aba and the king of Hesed came out, for from him they go on diminishing. Therefore he says, “The six lights that were with it entered the vessel of the king called Hesed,” for they are all included in him, as explained.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:42:2
items.html:
The looking of the eyes of Aba and Ima at one another: It has already been explained that this is the level of Keter of Aba, which is called by this name. And it is this that vanishes because of the breaking of the king of Daat, and the refinement of phase four that follows from it.
For the screen is revealed chiefly in the Guf, since in the Rosh it is only in potential and not in actuality. Therefore, when the vessel breaks, the discernment of the screen is found to be cancelled from that discernment of coarseness of which the vessel is made.
